titleEnglish: Ankh Uthi Mohabbat — Purnam Allahabadi / Traditional

verses.ar:
Ankh uthi mohabbat ne angrai li
Dil ka sauda huya chandi raat mein
verses.en:
The eye lifted — love stirred and stretched
The heart's bargain was struck on a moonlit night

verses.ar:
Raat yun dil mein teri bhooli hui yaad aayi
Jaise viraane mein chupke se bahaar aa jaye
Jaise sahraon mein haule se chale baad-ae-naseem
Jaise bimaar ko be-wajaah quraar aa jaaye
verses.en:
Last night your forgotten memory returned to my heart
Like spring arriving quietly in a desolate place
Like a gentle breeze moving softly through the desert
Like a sick one finding peace without reason

verses.ar:
Aaj ki baat phir nahin hogii
Yeh mulaqaat phir nahi hogii
Aise badal to phir bi aayenge
Aisi barsaat phir nahi hogi
Ik nazar murke dekhne wale
Kya yeh hairat phir nahi hogi
verses.en:
Tonight's conversation will not come again
This meeting will not happen again
Such clouds may come again
But such rain will not fall again
O you who turned to look just once
Will this wonder not come again?

verses.ar:
Us k nazdik ghum-e-tark e wafa kuch bhi nahi
Mutmain aesay hain wo jese huwa kuch bhi nahi
Ab tu hathon se lakeeren bhi mitti jati hain
Us ko kho ker tu mere pass raha kuch b nhi
verses.en:
To them the grief of abandoned faithfulness means nothing
They are at such peace as though nothing happened
Now even the lines on your hands are fading away
Having lost them — nothing of you remains with me

verses.ar:
Kal bicharna tu phir ehad-e-wafa soch k bandh
Abi aghaz-e-mohabbat he gaya kuch b nahi
Main tu is wastay chup ho k tamasha na bane
Tu smajta he mujhe tujh se gila kuch b nahi
verses.en:
Tomorrow we part — yet you sealed the vow of faithfulness again
The beginning of love itself has passed — nothing happened
I stayed silent only so it would not become a spectacle
You think I have no complaint against you — nothing

verses.ar:
Chaandni raat raad aati hai
Yeh mulaqaat yaad aati hai
Dekh kar un ghaneri zulfon ko
Mast barsaat yaad aati hai
verses.en:
On moonlit nights the memory returns like thunder
This very meeting comes to mind
Seeing those dark tresses
The intoxicating rain comes to mind

verses.ar:
Aankh uthi... Jis taraf uth gayi hain aanhen hain
Chasm-e-baddur kiya nigahen hain
Jidar uthai nazar qatl-e-aam tumne kiya
Qazaa ka naam huya aur kaam tumne kiya
verses.en:
The eye lifted — wherever those sighs have risen
What eyes they are — like the full moon
Whichever way you turned your gaze you caused a massacre
Death became the name — and you did the deed

verses.ar:
Unki nazron ne kuch aisa jaddo kiya
Lutt gaye hum to pehli mulaqat mein
Hum hosh bhi apne bhul gaye
Imaan bhi apna bhul gaye
Ik dil hi nahi us bas mein
Hum na jaane kiya kiya bhul gaye
verses.en:
Their glances cast such a spell upon us
We were plundered at the very first meeting
We forgot our own senses
We forgot our own faith
Not just the heart fell under their power
We forgot — God knows what all we forgot

verses.ar:
Jo baat thi unko kehne ki
Wo baat hi kehna bhul gaye
Gairon ke fasane yaad rahe
Hum apna fasana bhul gaye
verses.en:
The very thing we had to say to them
We forgot to say that very thing
The stories of others stayed in memory
We forgot our own story

verses.ar:
Kya kya nigah yaar bata hasin ho gayi
Bijli kabhi bani kabhi shamshin ho gayi
Mehfil mein baar baar uni par nazar gayi
Humne bachai lakh magar phir udar gayi
Unki nigah mein koi jadoo zaroor
Jis par padi usi ke jigar mein utar gayi
verses.en:
O friend — tell me — how beautiful that gaze became
Sometimes it became lightning, sometimes a sword
In the gathering my eyes went to them again and again
I tried a thousand times to hold back — but they went again
There is surely a magic in their glance
Whoever it fell upon — it pierced straight to their heart

verses.ar:
Banke tasweer-e-ghum reh gaye hain
Khoye khoye se hum reh gaye hain
Bant li sabne aapas mein khushiyaan
Mere hisse mein ghum reh gaye hain
Ab na uthna sarhaane se mere
Ab to ginti ke dum reh gaye hain
Aye saba aik zehmat zara kar
Unn ki zulfon mai hum reh gaye hain
Kainat e jafaa o wafaa mai
Aik tum aik hum reh gaye hain
verses.en:
We have become a portrait of sorrow
We remain lost and wandering
Everyone distributed happiness amongst themselves
In my share — only grief remained
Do not rise from my bedside now
Only a counted few breaths remain
O morning breeze — do me one kindness
In their tresses — we remain
In this universe of cruelty and faithfulness
Only you and I remain

verses.ar:
Nazar mila ke mere paas ja kar lut liya
Nazar hati thi ke phir muskura kar lut liya
Koi yeh lut toh dekho ke usne jab chaha
Mujh mein rehe kar mujhmein sama kar lut liya
Na lut-tay hum magar un mast angriyon ne jigar
Nazar bachaatey huay dub dubaa k loot liyaa
verses.en:
They met my gaze and coming close plundered me
They looked away and then with a smile plundered me again
Let someone see this plundering — whenever they wished
Remaining within me, merging into me, they plundered me
We would not have been plundered — but their intoxicated gestures
While averting their gaze, drowning slowly, plundered the heart

verses.ar:
Saath apnaa wafaa mai na chootay kabhi
Pyaar ki dor ban kar naa chootay kabhi
Choot jaye zamaana koi gham nahi
Haath teraa rahey mere haath mai
verses.en:
In faithfulness may we never be separated
Becoming the thread of love may we never be severed
Let the whole world go — no grief in that
As long as your hand remains in mine
